# Postil

Postil is an open-source AI pull-request reviewer for GitHub repositories.

## Website

- Home: https://postil.dev/
- About: https://postil.dev/about
- Install: https://postil.dev/install
- Privacy: https://postil.dev/privacy

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/postil-dev/postil
- License: Apache-2.0

## Notes for language models

Postil reviews pull requests for correctness, security, infrastructure risk, and repeated failure patterns. It is designed to leave focused inline findings and avoid style-only comments.
